title: 编程与技术关键词
html:
编程与技术关键词

概述

本章汇集开发工作中最常用的英语词汇，分为开发核心词汇、架构与设计、版本控制与协作、测试与质量四个部分。它帮助读者读懂英文文档、参与技术讨论并用英语描述开发工作。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，兼顾口头沟通与书面记录。建议把核心词汇与其常见搭配一起记忆，这样在讨论技术方案时能直接成句。

开发核心词汇

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
compile v. 编译 compile the code, compilation error
debug v. 调试 debug the issue, debugging tools
deploy v. 部署 deploy to production, deployment pipeline
refactor v. 重构 refactor code, code refactoring
optimize v. 优化 optimize performance, optimization strategy
integrate v. 集成 integrate with, system integration

听说例句

A: The code won't compile. I'm getting a type error. B: Let me debug it. It's probably a missing type annotation from the refactor.

A: Should we optimize this before deployment? B: Yes, let's run the profiler first, then deploy after we integrate the performance fix.

写作表达

  • The team refactored the legacy module to improve maintainability and reduce compilation time.
  • After thorough optimization, the system was deployed to production with zero downtime.

架构与设计

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
architecture n. 架构 system architecture, microservice architecture
component n. 组件 reusable component, UI component
module n. 模块 core module, independent module
interface n. 接口 API interface, user interface
dependency n. 依赖 dependency injection, resolve dependencies
abstraction n. 抽象 level of abstraction, abstraction layer

听说例句

A: What's the overall architecture of the new system? B: It's a microservice architecture with separate modules for auth, payment, and notification.

A: Should we add an abstraction layer? B: Yes, it will help decouple the components and reduce hard dependencies.

写作表达

  • The system architecture consists of three core modules, each with a well-defined interface.
  • Introducing an abstraction layer between the UI components and the data source simplifies future migrations.

版本控制与协作

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
commit n./v. 提交 commit changes, commit message
branch n. 分支 feature branch, merge branch
merge v. 合并 merge request, merge conflict
pull request n. 拉取请求 open a PR, review a PR
repository n. 仓库 code repository, remote repository
revert v. 回退 revert a commit, revert changes

听说例句

A: Can you review my pull request? B: Sure, I'll take a look. Is it ready to merge or still a draft?

A: There's a merge conflict on the main branch. B: Let me rebase my branch and resolve the conflict before pushing again.

写作表达

  • All feature branches must go through a pull request review before being merged into the main branch.
  • The breaking change was reverted immediately after the deployment to minimize user impact.

测试与质量

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
unit test n. 单元测试 write unit tests, unit test coverage
integration test n. 集成测试 run integration tests, integration testing
assertion n. 断言 test assertion, assert that
coverage n. 覆盖率 code coverage, increase coverage
regression n. 回归 regression test, prevent regression
mock n./v. 模拟 mock data, mock the API

听说例句

A: What's our current test coverage? B: Around 75%. We need more unit tests for the payment module to prevent regression.

A: Should I mock the external API for this test? B: Yes, use a mock to keep the integration test fast and deterministic.

写作表达

  • The test suite includes over 2,000 unit tests and 150 integration tests, achieving 85% code coverage.
  • Regression tests were added to ensure that the fix does not introduce new issues in related modules.
